    ∃ ν : Nat → Nat, (∀ t, ν t ≤ Nof j c p t) ∧

theorem blocks_to_pair {b j L1 L2 : Nat} (hb : 1 < b) (hj : 0 < j)

    (hlen : ∀ t, t < j → (B t).length = occ t (clsOf j 0 L1) + occ t (clsOf j 0 L2))
    (hone : ∀ v, v < b → sumRange (fun t => occ v (B t)) j = 1)
    (hlead1 : nth (B ((L1 - 1) % j)) (occ ((L1 - 1) % j) (clsOf j 0 L1) - 1) ≠ 0)
    (hlead2 : nth (B ((L2 - 1) % j))
        (occ ((L2 - 1) % j) (clsOf j 0 L1) + occ ((L2 - 1) % j) (clsOf j 0 L2) - 1) ≠ 0) :
    ∃ d1 d2 : List Nat,
      d1.length = L1 ∧ d2.length = L2 ∧
      (∀ v, v < b → occ v (d1 ++ d2) = 1) ∧
      nth d1 (L1 - 1) ≠ 0 ∧ nth d2 (L2 - 1) ≠ 0 ∧
      (valOf b d1 + valOf b d2) % (b ^ j - 1)
        = sumRange (fun t => b ^ t * (B t).sum) j % (b ^ j - 1)

theorem sumRange_congr {f g : Nat → Nat} :
    ∀ n, (∀ t, t < n → f t = g t) → sumRange f n = sumRange g n

name: Nice.sumRange_eq_one
statement:
theorem sumRange_eq_one {f : Nat → Nat} : ∀ n, sumRange f n = 1 →
    ∃ t0, t0 < n ∧ f t0 = 1 ∧ ∀ t, t < n → t ≠ t0 → f t = 0

name: Nice.sumRange_eq_zero
statement: theorem sumRange_eq_zero {f : Nat → Nat} : ∀ n, sumRange f n = 0 → ∀ t, t < n → f t = 0

name: Nice.sumRange_front
statement:
theorem sumRange_front (f : Nat → Nat) : ∀ n,
    sumRange f (n + 1) = f 0 + sumRange (fun t => f (t + 1)) n

name: Nice.sumRange_mod_congr
statement:
theorem sumRange_mod_congr {f g : Nat → Nat} {d : Nat} : ∀ n,
    (∀ t, t < n → f t % d = g t % d) → sumRange f n % d = sumRange g n % d

name: Nice.sumRange_mul
statement:
theorem sumRange_mul (k : Nat) (f : Nat → Nat) : ∀ n,
    k * sumRange f n = sumRange (fun t => k * f t) n

name: Nice.sumRange_nxt
statement:
theorem sumRange_nxt {j : Nat} (hj : 0 < j) (f : Nat → Nat) :
    sumRange (fun t => f (nxt j t)) j = sumRange f j

name: Nice.sumRange_occ_length
statement:
theorem sumRange_occ_length {j : Nat} : ∀ (l : List Nat), (∀ x, x ∈ l → x < j) →
    sumRange (fun t => occ t l) j = l.length

name: Nice.sumRange_occ_wsum
statement:
theorem sumRange_occ_wsum {j : Nat} : ∀ (l : List Nat), (∀ x, x ∈ l → x < j) →
    sumRange (fun t => t * occ t l) j = l.sum

name: Nice.sumRange_one
statement: theorem sumRange_one : ∀ n, sumRange (fun _ => 1) n = n

name: Nice.sumRange_prv
statement:
theorem sumRange_prv {j : Nat} (hj : 0 < j) (f : Nat → Nat) :
    sumRange (fun t => f (prv j t)) j = sumRange f j

name: Nice.sumRange_update
statement:
theorem sumRange_update {f g : Nat → Nat} {t0 x : Nat} :
    ∀ j, t0 < j → (∀ t, t ≠ t0 → g t = f t) → x + g t0 = f t0 →
    x + sumRange g j = sumRange f j

name: Nice.sumRange_zero
statement: theorem sumRange_zero {f : Nat → Nat} : ∀ n, (∀ t, t < n → f t = 0) → sumRange f n = 0

name: Nice.sum_aOf
statement:
theorem sum_aOf {j : Nat} (hj : 0 < j) (c p : Nat → Nat)
    (hpc : ∀ t, t < j → p t ≤ c t) : sumRange (aOf j c p) j = sumRange c j

name: Nice.sum_factor
statement: theorem sum_factor (ρ e1 d : Nat) : ρ ^ e1 + ρ ^ (e1 + (d+1)) = ρ ^ e1 * (1 + ρ ^ (d+1))

name: Nice.sum_runs
statement:
theorem sum_runs (a : Nat → Nat) : ∀ n,
    sumRange (fun t => (run (sumRange a t) (a t)).sum) n = (run 0 (sumRange a n)).sum

name: Nice.sum_shape
statement:
theorem sum_shape {S a' q : Nat} (hdiv : 2 ^ (a'+1) * q + 2 ^ a' = S) :
    S = 2 ^ a' * (2 * q + 1)

name: Nice.target_eq
statement:
theorem target_eq {b T A : Nat} (hb : 1 < b) (hT : 2 * T = b * (b - 1))
    (hA : 2 * A = b - 1) : T % (b - 1) = A % (b - 1)

name: Nice.target_zero
statement:
theorem target_zero {b T : Nat} (hb : 1 < b) (hT : 2 * T = b * (b - 1))
    (hbe : b % 2 = 0) : T % (b - 1) = 0

name: Nice.topSlots_const
statement:
theorem topSlots_const {b e h L a c n : Nat} (han : a ≤ n) (hnc : n < c)
    (hq : a ^ e / b ^ (L - h) = (c - 1) ^ e / b ^ (L - h)) :
    topSlots b h L (n ^ e) = topSlots b h L (a ^ e)

name: Nice.two_adic_split
statement: theorem two_adic_split : ∀ x : Nat, 0 < x → ∃ v u, x = 2 ^ v * u ∧ u % 2 = 1

name: Nice.two_four_base_seventeen_dead
statement: theorem two_four_base_seventeen_dead (ρ : Nat) : (ρ ^ 2 + ρ ^ 4) % 16 ≠ 136 % 16

name: Nice.two_four_base_thirtythree_live
statement: theorem two_four_base_thirtythree_live : (4 ^ 2 + 4 ^ 4) % 32 = 528 % 32

name: Nice.two_four_base_twelve_dead
statement: theorem two_four_base_twelve_dead (n : Nat) : ¬ Pandigital 12 2 4 n

name: Nice.two_four_no_solution
statement:
theorem two_four_no_solution {b n : Nat} (hb : 1 < b) (hmod : b % 3 = 1) :
    numDigits b (n ^ 2) + numDigits b (n ^ 4) ≠ b

name: Nice.two_pow_odd_unique
statement:
theorem two_pow_odd_unique {i j U V : Nat} (hU : U % 2 = 1) (hV : V % 2 = 1)
    (h : 2 ^ i * U = 2 ^ j * V) : i = j

name: Nice.two_sumRange_id
statement: theorem two_sumRange_id : ∀ n, 2 * sumRange (fun t => t) (n + 1) = (n + 1) * n

name: Nice.two_three_band_nonempty
statement:
theorem two_three_band_nonempty {b : Nat} (hb : 8 ≤ b) (hmod : b % 5 ≠ 1) :
    ∃ n, InBand b 2 3 n

name: Nice.valOf_digits
statement: theorem valOf_digits {b : Nat} (hb : 1 < b) : ∀ x, valOf b (digits b x) = x

name: Nice.valOf_mod_pow_sub_one
statement:
theorem valOf_mod_pow_sub_one {b j : Nat} (hb : 1 < b) (hj : 0 < j) (ds : List Nat) :
    valOf b ds % (b ^ j - 1) = wsum b j 0 ds % (b ^ j - 1)

name: Nice.valOf_mod_pred
statement:
theorem valOf_mod_pred {b : Nat} (hb : 1 < b) (ds : List Nat) :
    valOf b ds % (b - 1) = ds.sum % (b - 1)

name: Nice.valOf_mod_wsum
statement:
theorem valOf_mod_wsum {b j : Nat} (hb : 1 < b) (hj : 0 < j) :
    ∀ (ds : List Nat) (t : Nat),
      (b ^ t * valOf b ds) % (b ^ j - 1) = wsum b j (t % j) ds % (b ^ j - 1)

name: Nice.wcls_append
statement:
theorem wcls_append (b : Nat) : ∀ (l1 : List Nat) (d1 : List Nat) (l2 d2 : List Nat),
    l1.length = d1.length →
    wcls b (l1 ++ l2) (d1 ++ d2) = wcls b l1 d1 + wcls b l2 d2

name: Nice.wrap_sum
statement:
theorem wrap_sum {b j : Nat} (hb : 0 < b) (hj : 0 < j) (τ : Nat → Nat) :
    sumRange (fun t => b ^ t * τ (prv j t)) j + (b ^ j - 1) * τ (j - 1)
      = sumRange (fun t => b ^ (t + 1) * τ t) j

name: Nice.wsum_cons
statement:
theorem wsum_cons (b j t d : Nat) (ds : List Nat) :
    wsum b j t (d :: ds) = b ^ t * d + wsum b j ((t + 1) % j) ds

name: Nice.wsum_eq_wcls
statement:
theorem wsum_eq_wcls (b j : Nat) : ∀ (ds : List Nat) (t : Nat),
    wsum b j t ds = wcls b (clsOf j t ds.length) ds

name: Nice.wsum_nil
statement: theorem wsum_nil (b j t : Nat) : wsum b j t [] = 0

name: Nice.wsum_one
statement: theorem wsum_one (b : Nat) : ∀ ds : List Nat, wsum b 1 0 ds = ds.sum

name: Nice.yield_ge
statement:
theorem yield_ge {b q M E : Nat} (hq : q * E + 2 = b)
    (hbig : 4 ^ (2 * E) ≤ b) (hM : M + 4 ≤ b) : M * b ^ b ≤ b ^ q * fact b
